name: Consent
annotation: Legal consent gate (pre-auth onboarding). Cinematic focal moment: two required checkbox rows (Terms of Service, Privacy Policy) gate a single full-width BtnPrimary CTA; an optional marketing toggle sits below in its own card; a derived local acceptance counter (never provenance-chipped) tracks 0 of 2 -> 2 of 2 ready in forest green. No fake metrics, no pre-checked boxes, no bottom nav (pre-auth, single CTA only).

modules.build: StatusBar, default state — time/signal/battery, dark-shell ink styling over the amber-radial atmosphere. No CIA synthesis badge: pre-auth legal gate has no personalized read to surface.
Centered Balencia wordmark + 48x48pt mark, no tagline. First element in the entrance stagger (0ms fade-in, downward drift), establishing the pre-auth brand moment before the legal ask.
Display 34 "Before we *begin*" (Tiempos italic on "begin"), centered; Body-light 16 "Review and accept our policies to continue" beneath, centered. Enters at 50ms stagger, after the wordmark.

SolidCard #211008, radius 28, no blur. Overline "REQUIRED". Row 1: ConsentCheckbox (unchecked) + "I accept the Terms of Service" + chevron -> opens ToS Sheet. Hairline divider rgba(255,255,255,.06). Row 2: ConsentCheckbox (unchecked) + "I accept the Privacy Policy" + chevron -> opens Privacy Sheet. Row tap toggles box; label tap opens Sheet.

GlassCard default, radius 28, --glow-you (orange) bleed — brightens 10% when toggled on. Overline "OPTIONAL". Row: "Send me tips and updates" + Toggle (off), track --surface-3, active fill #FF5E00, thumb paper-50.

Body-light 15, tabular-nums, centered. Cold start "0 of 2 required"; partial "1 of 2 required"; gate-ready "2 of 2  ready" turns forest green #34A853. Derived local state — no provenance chip (same-frame user taps, zero source ambiguity).

BtnPrimary full-width "Continue", h52 r999 #FF5E00 fill, paper-50 label. Disabled 40% until 2-of-2 gate-ready. Loading: label->spinner, width locked. Success: 250ms forest-green flash -> push CIA Onboarding [07]. Offline: label -> "You need a *connection* to continue", disabled; OfflineBanner shows.
HomeIndicator, system default, dark-shell styling. No floating tab nav — pre-auth onboarding gate has no Today/CIA/Goals/Me tabs; the single BtnPrimary is the only persistent action per canon.

notes: Shell corrected to DARK: though 03c sits in the auth-family numbering (default assumption warm-light), this spec's own Visual System section explicitly commits to warm dark base #0A0A0F + top-center amber radial glow + grain — the spec-declared override wins per source hierarchy. Italic word resolved to "begin" (literal Final Composition header copy, positioned/sized at Display 34) over the Visual System's generic "*consent*" label, which does not appear as literal rendered copy anywhere in the spec; "connection" is a separate, state-scoped italic word used only in the Offline CTA variant, not the cold-start default render — canon's one-italic-word rule is read as per default composition. hasNav=false / hasFab=false: pre-auth onboarding screen, no Today/CIA/Goals/Me pill, single CTA only. imageSlots=[] per spec ("None required"). No overflow past y844 — belowFold=[]. Not modularized as separate build slots (still spec-true, just off the primary composition, ≤8-module cap): Sheet (full variant, houses ToS/Privacy doc text, TopBar back+title, grabber pill, scrim rgba(10,10,15,.6), 250ms spring-in, one instance per document) with in-sheet ErrorState (glyph + "Could not load the page. Check your connection." + BtnSecondary retry); inline-error state ("Accept both to continue", CTA shakes 10px transform-only, only reachable if gate logic is bypassed); density-variant ghost links ("Email preferences" low density / "Data control" high density, referenced section 11, density not resolvable from given evidence). Accessibility: paper-100 (#FEFAF3) on #211008 = 17.6:1 (AAA); paper-100 @64% on #211008 = 7.7:1 (AAA, corrects draft's under-claimed 16.5:1/AA-only); ConsentCheckbox is a NEW primitive, 24px visual box with an independent 44x44pt tap target, distinct from the ListRow's own 56px min-height band (catalog value, corrects draft's 52px); Toggle thumb tap target padded to 44px. ConsentCard/.glass-card naming contradiction in draft resolved to plain GlassCard (default) per spec correction. OfflineBanner/SyncStatus copy adapted honestly (no fabricated "last sync" timestamp — this is a one-time pre-auth screen with no prior sync history).
trustControls: Required checkbox — "I accept the Terms of Service" (unchecked by default, opens ToS Sheet)
Required checkbox — "I accept the Privacy Policy" (unchecked by default, opens Privacy Sheet)
Optional toggle — "Send me tips and updates" (off by default, fully skippable, no dark-pattern default-on)
Acceptance counter — honest-null "0 of 2 required" -> "2 of 2  ready" (derived local state, no fabricated provenance chip)
CTA gate — BtnPrimary disabled 40% opacity until both required boxes checked; never pre-checked, no nagging re-prompts

Offline honesty — CTA label swaps to "You need a *connection* to continue" + OfflineBanner "No connection right now - you can review, but continue needs you online"; checkbox/toggle state preserved untouched
